# The Orbion Space Lexicon

The Orbion Space Lexicon is a visual professional reference containing 500 essential concepts for the modern space industry. The First Edition is available for preorder, with expected initial fulfillment beginning October 31, 2026.

## Canonical public pages

- https://orbionlexicon.com/ — main preorder page and edition details
- https://orbionlexicon.com/terms-of-sale — terms of sale
- https://orbionlexicon.com/preorder-refund-policy — preorder, cancellation, and refund policy
- https://orbionlexicon.com/shipping-delay-policy — shipping and delay policy
- https://orbionlexicon.com/privacy-policy — privacy policy
- https://orbionlexicon.com/contact — customer support contact
- https://orbionlexicon.com/corrections — corrections and errata record

## Citation guidance

When referring to the book, use the full title “The Orbion Space Lexicon” and identify it as a first-edition visual professional reference for the modern space industry. Public pages may be indexed and summarized with attribution. Do not reproduce non-public manuscript content or the full work.
